agent-of-the-ninth-quill.summary: A clever burglar recruited by the Ninth Quill, a ring of spies and saboteurs who rob wizards of their tomes and relics, picking up a few spy-craft spells along the way.

bejeweled-conclave-spy.summary: Outwardly a courtier, go-between or performer, secretly an informant schooled by the Bejeweled Conclave's enchanters to charm, infiltrate and trade in secrets.

cosmic-dawn-experiment.summary: Reshaped by the Bringers of the Cosmic Dawn's transmutations, whether as an unlucky test subject or a willing member chasing a better body, and now turning that odd anatomy to advantage.

covenant-of-the-grave-recruit.summary: Drawn to the mysteries of death, studied mortality with the Covenant of the Grave as a cold science, learning medicine, history and a little necromancy.

crucible-storm-chaser.summary: A thrill-seeker who joined the Crucible Keepers to study disasters both natural and magical, happiest working molten glass or running into the heart of a storm.

familiar-trainer.summary: Bonded with a magical familiar in childhood and grew up alongside it; now the two work as a team, and the creature keeps finding small delights on the road.

horizon-weaver-initiate.summary: Restless from youth, set out wandering early and met the Horizon Weavers, travelling conjurers who taught a little teleportation to speed the journey.

phantasmic-circus-trouper.summary: Found a family in the touring Phantasmic Circus, on stage or behind it, and learned illusion magic, showmanship and sleight of attention.

seer-apprentice.summary: Trained with the Seers of Sea and Sky to read small omens in clouds and deep water, studied in their libraries, and now wanders offering counsel and help.

ward-of-the-sheltering-hands.summary: Taken in by the Sheltering Hands after hard luck, a charity that guards the vulnerable, and taught its protective magic in the hope of one day sheltering others.
